lines.text: God tells the Israelites not to make gods of silver or gold, but to make Him an altar of earth.
God says an altar of stones must not be shaped with a chisel, because that would defile it.
God forbids oppressing foreigners because Israel was once foreign in Moab, and He will hear the cry of mistreated widows.
A neighbor's cloak taken as collateral must be returned by noon, because it is his only covering.
Three times a year the Israelites celebrate a feast to God, eating unleavened bread for seven days.
